name: divergence_plus_level_confluence_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index sells down to test a structural level — PDL, session VWAP, or a major round number like 22000 or 22500 — resting institutional buy orders at those pre-programmed price points absorb incremental selling. RSI bullish divergence (price lower low, RSI higher low) measured over the past 5 minutes confirms that selling momentum is thinning precisely as price arrives at the structural support: each successive push lower takes more selling to achieve, while passive buyers hold the level. The level provides a structural reason for reversal (stop clustering, VWAP-benchmarked algorithm accumulation) while divergence confirms momentum exhaustion — two independent reasons to reverse. Bearish divergence at PDH or VWAP resistance symmetrically marks exhaustion of buy-side flow at distributed institutional sell levels, triggering a 15-25 spot point reversal that translates to 7-12 option premium points.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute RSI to detect momentum exhaustion within the 5-min divergence window. NOT 9×12=108 (original's time equivalent) because at 5s resolution we are trading the first 30-90 seconds of the reversal — RSI(36) is responsive enough to form a visible divergence within 5 minutes while filtering single-bar noise. RSI(108) would require a 9-minute momentum window, making divergence detection too slow for 15-120s trades.

indicators.name: bullish_divergence
indicators.formula: close < min(close, 60-bar window) AND rsi_36 > rsi_36_at_prior_close_min AND rsi_36 < rsi_low_threshold
indicators.purpose: 5-minute divergence window (60 bars). Original used 20-bar × 1-min = 20-min window. Compressed to 5-min because we hold 15-120s — the divergence must be recent enough to be actionable. A 20-min comparison would detect structural divergences that take 10-30 min to resolve, not the 30-90s reversal we're targeting.

indicators.name: bearish_divergence
indicators.formula: close > max(close, 60-bar window) AND rsi_36 < rsi_36_at_prior_close_max AND rsi_36 > rsi_high_threshold
indicators.purpose: Same 5-minute window as bullish_divergence. Detects buying exhaustion at resistance levels.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close × volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative intraday VWAP. No scaling — VWAP is always measured from session open regardless of bar size. Key structural level for VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms.

indicators.name: pdh_pdl
indicators.purpose: Structural daily levels where stop orders cluster. No scaling — PDH/PDL are fixed session anchor prices.

conditions: bullish_divergence == True (price lower low, RSI higher low in past 5 min)
at_support == True (within proximity_pct of PDL, VWAP below, or major round number)
rsi_36 < rsi_low_threshold (default 42 — in low momentum territory)
buy_ce.confirmation: signal fires on bar close; bullish divergence confirms momentum exhaustion at structural support

conditions: bearish_divergence == True (price higher high, RSI lower high in past 5 min)
at_resistance == True (within proximity_pct of PDH, VWAP above, or major round number)
rsi_36 > rsi_high_threshold (default 58 — in high momentum territory)
buy_pe.confirmation: signal fires on bar close; bearish divergence confirms momentum exhaustion at structural resistance

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts ≈ 10 spot pts at delta 0.5 — if NIFTY breaks 10 pts beyond the structural level after a divergence signal, the level has failed and the thesis is invalidated; 10 spot pts is the 1-sigma NIFTY move in 30-60 seconds, so a stop breach means the reversal is not materializing
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts ≈ 16 spot pts — divergence reversals at structural levels on NIFTY typically produce 15-25 spot point first-leg bounces; 8 pts captures ~60% of the expected move at 1:1.6 risk:reward, consistent with the original's 60% win rate estimate

filters.vix_filter: none — divergence + level works in both low and high vol regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST; skip first 15 min (09:15-09:30) where PDH/PDL proximity is noisy due to overnight gap
filters.volume_filter: none — divergence detection implicitly captures when price moves with diminishing force
filters.trend_filter: none — counter-trend by design; divergence explicitly fades the current trend at structural levels
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — PDH/PDL and VWAP levels are persistent structural anchors; divergence at levels is a durable microstructure pattern driven by algo order clustering

adaptation_notes: Original traded top-25 Nifty50 stocks individually, requiring a per-stock universe scan. Converted to single NIFTY index with the same mechanism: RSI divergence + structural level confluence. Key changes: (1) RSI period compressed from 9-min equivalent to 3-min (RSI 36 bars) because index divergences form and resolve faster than individual stock divergences; (2) divergence window compressed from 20-min to 5-min because index option hold time is 15-120s vs 10-45 min for stocks; (3) round numbers set to 100-pt steps for NIFTY (vs 0.1% proximity on individual stocks); (4) removed 'event filter' (no stock result days on an index); (5) removed spread filter — no spread cost with limit orders. VWAP and PDH/PDL logic preserved directly.
weaknesses: Divergence + level confluence on 5-min windows fires rarely — possibly 0-2 signals per session on NIFTY
Round number proximity (100-pt steps) at NIFTY 22000 covers ~0.1% range; if proximity_pct is too wide, false level confluences increase
5-second bar divergence detection is inherently noisy — many 'new lows' are 1-bar spikes, not real swings
NIFTY index is smoother than individual stocks so RSI divergences are shallower and less frequent
